```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

The purpose of his script is to determine is any SFARI genes are included in the signficiant TT genes for males.

##Load Packages

```{r load package}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(readxl)
library(Signac)
library(glue)
library(cowplot)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(patchwork)
library(Matrix)

set.seed(123)
```

## Import data

```{r import SFARI gene list, androgen response genes, and TT results}
SFARI_Gene <- read_csv("../../doc/targeted/SFARI-Gene_genes_07-08-2025release_07-22-2025export.csv", col_types = cols(status = col_skip()))

androgen_response_up <- read_csv("../../doc/targeted/Upregulated_DEGs.csv", col_names = FALSE)
androgen_response_down <- read_csv("../../doc/targeted/Downregulated_DEGs.csv", col_names = FALSE)

mouse_response <- read_csv("../../doc/targeted/converted_sex_tt_mouse.csv")

TT_results <- read_csv("../../results/targeted/TT_results.csv")
```


```{r filter gene list and TT genes}
SFARI_Gene_filt <- SFARI_Gene %>% dplyr::filter(`gene-score` <= 2)

TT_sig_results <- TT_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(sex == "M") %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) >= 0.25)

androgen_response_all <- c(androgen_response_up$X1, androgen_response_down$X1)

mouse_response_genes <- mouse_response$symbol_human
```


```{r check for intersect}
SFARI_shared_genes <- intersect(SFARI_Gene_filt$`gene-symbol`, TT_sig_results$gene)
SFARI_shared_genes

SFARI_shared_sig_results <- TT_sig_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% SFARI_shared_genes)

# again for androgen response
ar_shared_genes <- intersect(androgen_response_all, TT_sig_results$gene)
ar_shared_genes

# again for androgen response
mouse_shared_genes <- intersect(mouse_response_genes, TT_sig_results$gene)
mouse_shared_genes
```

```{r visualize SFARI genes}
plot_SFARI_genes_from_subsets <- function(by_group_data, output_dir, hormone, top_n = 6) {
  dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  message("Number of groups to plot: ", length(by_group_data))
  
  purrr::walk(by_group_data, function(group_list) {
    if (is.null(group_list)) {
      message("  Skipping NULL group")
      return()
    }
    
    limma_res <- group_list$limma_results
    counts_sub <- group_list$counts_sub  # genes x samples
    metadata_sub <- group_list$metadata_sub

    if (nrow(metadata_sub) < 1 || ncol(counts_sub) < 1) {
      message("  Skipping empty subset: ", metadata_sub$cell_type[1], "_", metadata_sub$Sex[1])
      return()
    }

    # Compute log1p(CPM)
    counts_cpm <- edgeR::cpm(counts_sub, log = FALSE)
    counts_log <- log1p(counts_cpm)
    
    # Transpose counts: samples x genes
    counts_log <- t(counts_log)

    top_genes <- limma_res %>%
      filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) >= 0.25) %>%
      filter(gene %in% SFARI_Gene_filt$`gene-symbol`) %>%
      pull(gene)

    message("  Plotting group: ", metadata_sub$cell_type[1], "_", metadata_sub$Sex[1])
    message("  Top genes: ", paste(top_genes, collapse = ", "))

    plot_list <- purrr::map(top_genes, function(gene) {
      if (!gene %in% colnames(counts_log)) {
        message("    Gene ", gene, " not in counts — skipping")
        return(NULL)
      }

      expr_vals <- counts_log[, gene]
      if (all(is.na(expr_vals)) || all(expr_vals == 0)) {
        message("    Gene ", gene, " has all NA or zero expression — skipping")
        return(NULL)
      }

      df <- metadata_sub %>% mutate(expr = expr_vals)

      ggplot(df, aes_string(x = hormone, y = "expr", color = "Sex", fill = "Sex")) +
        geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("M" = "steelblue", "F" = "violetred3")) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("M" = "steelblue", "F" = "violetred3")) +
        labs(title = paste0(gene, " in ", metadata_sub$cell_type[1], " (", metadata_sub$Sex[1], ")"),
             x = hormone, y = "log1p(CPM)") +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
    }) %>% compact()

    if (length(plot_list) == 0) {
      message("    No valid plots for group")
      return()
    }

    combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = 2)
    clean_name <- paste0(metadata_sub$cell_type[1], "_", metadata_sub$Sex[1])
    clean_name <- gsub("/", "-", clean_name)

    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(clean_name, "_top_genes.png")),
           plot = combined_plot, width = 10, height = 6 + ceiling(length(plot_list)/2), dpi = 300)
    message("  ✅ Saved plot for ", clean_name)
  })
}

plot_SFARI_genes_from_subsets(res_TT$by_group_data, "../../results/targeted/SFARI_testosterone_plots", hormone = "TT")

```


```{r show overlap with stacked chart}

plot_SFARI_genes_from_subsets <- function(by_group_data, output_dir, hormone, top_n = 6) {
  dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  message("Number of groups to plot: ", length(by_group_data))
  
  purrr::walk(by_group_data, function(group_list) {
    if (is.null(group_list)) {
      message("  Skipping NULL group")
      return()
    }
    
    limma_res <- group_list$limma_results
    counts_sub <- group_list$counts_sub  # genes x samples
    metadata_sub <- group_list$metadata_sub

    if (nrow(metadata_sub) < 1 || ncol(counts_sub) < 1) {
      message("  Skipping empty subset: ", metadata_sub$cell_type[1], "_", metadata_sub$Sex[1])
      return()
    }

    # Compute log1p(CPM)
    counts_cpm <- edgeR::cpm(counts_sub, log = FALSE)
    counts_log <- log1p(counts_cpm)
    
    # Transpose counts: samples x genes
    counts_log <- t(counts_log)

    top_genes <- limma_res %>%
      filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) >= 0.25) %>%
      filter(gene %in% SFARI_Gene$`gene-symbol`) %>%
      pull(gene)

    if (length(top_genes) == 0) {
      message("  No top genes found—skipping")
      return()
    }
    
    # Create a data frame for the counts
    counts_long <- reshape2::melt(counts_cpm)
    colnames(counts_long) <- c("Gene", "Sample", "CPM")

    # Identify SFARI genes
    counts_long$SFARI_Status <- ifelse(counts_long$Gene %in% SFARI_Gene$`gene-symbol`, "SFARI", "Other")

    # Aggregate counts (CPM) by gene and SFARI status
    counts_agg <- counts_long %>%
      group_by(SFARI_Status, Gene) %>%
      summarize(Average_CPM = mean(CPM))

    # Sort the genes by average CPM
    counts_agg_sorted <- counts_agg %>%
      arrange(desc(Average_CPM)) %>%
      top_n(top_n, wt = Average_CPM)

    message("  Plotting group: ", metadata_sub$cell_type[1], "_", metadata_sub$Sex[1])
    message("  Top genes: ", paste(counts_agg_sorted$Gene, collapse = ", "))

    # Create stacked bar plot
    stacked_bar_plot <- ggplot(counts_agg_sorted, aes(x = reorder(Gene, Average_CPM), y = Average_CPM, fill = SFARI_Status)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
      labs(title = paste0("Top ", top_n, " Genes in ", metadata_sub$cell_type[1], " (", metadata_sub$Sex[1], ")"),
           x = "Gene", y = "Average CPM") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

    clean_name <- paste0(metadata_sub$cell_type[1], "_", metadata_sub$Sex[1])
    clean_name <- gsub("/", "-", clean_name)

    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(clean_name, "_stacked_bar_genes.png")),
           plot = stacked_bar_plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
    message("  ✅ Saved stacked bar plot for ", clean_name)
  })
}

plot_SFARI_genes_from_subsets(res_TT$by_group_data, "../../results/targeted/SFARI_testosterone_plots", hormone = "TT")

```

```{r make stacked bar chart with all cell types}

summarize_sig_genes <- function(results, SFARI_Gene, cell_type, sex, fdr_cutoff = 0.05, logfc_cutoff = 0.25) {
  required_cols <- c("adj.P.Val", "logFC", "gene")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% colnames(results))) {
    warning("Missing required columns in results. Skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  sig <- results %>% filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff)
  if (!is.null(logfc_cutoff)) {
    sig <- sig %>% filter(abs(logFC) >= logfc_cutoff)
  }

  if (nrow(sig) == 0) return(NULL)

  sig %>%
    mutate(SFARI_Status = ifelse(gene %in% SFARI_Gene$`gene-symbol`, "SFARI", "Other"),
           cell_type = cell_type,
           sex = sex) %>%
    count(cell_type, sex, SFARI_Status, name = "num_sig_genes") %>%
    arrange(desc(num_sig_genes))
}

plot_sig_gene_summary <- function(summary_df, title) {
  ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = cell_type, y = num_sig_genes, fill = SFARI_Status)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    geom_text(aes(label = num_sig_genes), 
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), 
              color = "white", size = 4) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Cell Type", y = "# Significant Genes")+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("SFARI" = "steelblue", "Other" = "lightblue")) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "SFARI Status")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) 
}


plot_SFARI_genes_from_subsets <- function(by_group_data, SFARI_Gene, output_dir, hormone, top_n = 6) {
  dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  message("Number of groups to plot: ", length(by_group_data))

  all_summaries <- map_dfr(by_group_data, function(group_list) {
    if (is.null(group_list)) {
      message("  Skipping NULL group")
      return(NULL)
    }

    limma_res <- group_list$limma_results
    counts_sub <- group_list$counts_sub  # genes x samples
    metadata_sub <- group_list$metadata_sub

    if (is.null(metadata_sub) || is.null(counts_sub) ||
        nrow(metadata_sub) < 1 || ncol(counts_sub) < 1) {
      message("  Skipping empty or malformed subset")
      return(NULL)
    }

    if (!all(c("cell_type", "Sex") %in% colnames(metadata_sub))) {
      warning("  Missing 'cell_type' or 'Sex' in metadata_sub. Skipping group.")
      return(NULL)
    }

    if (metadata_sub$Sex[1] != "M") {
      message("  Skipping non-male group: ", metadata_sub$cell_type[1], "_", metadata_sub$Sex[1])
      return(NULL)
    }

    summarize_sig_genes(
      limma_res,
      SFARI_Gene,
      metadata_sub$cell_type[1],
      metadata_sub$Sex[1]
    )
  })

  if (is.null(all_summaries) || nrow(all_summaries) == 0) {
    message("No significant genes found across male groups")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Plot the combined summary of significant genes for males only
  plot_title <- paste("Significant Gene Summary Across Male Groups (", hormone, ")", sep = "")
  summary_plot <- plot_sig_gene_summary(all_summaries, plot_title)
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "combined_sig_gene_summary_male.png"),
         plot = summary_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
  message("  ✅ Saved combined summary plot (male only)")
}

# Call function — now only for male subsets
plot_SFARI_genes_from_subsets(
  by_group_data = res_TT$by_group_data,
  SFARI_Gene = SFARI_Gene,
  output_dir = "../../results/targeted/SFARI_testosterone_plots",
  hormone = "TT"
)

```


```{r join SFARI information}
summarize_sig_genes <- function(results, SFARI_Gene, cell_type, sex, fdr_cutoff = 0.05, logfc_cutoff = 0.25) {
  required_cols <- c("adj.P.Val", "logFC", "gene")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% colnames(results))) {
    warning("Missing required columns in results. Skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  sig <- results %>% filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff)
  if (!is.null(logfc_cutoff)) {
    sig <- sig %>% filter(abs(logFC) >= logfc_cutoff)
  }

  if (nrow(sig) == 0) return(NULL)

  sig <- sig %>%
    left_join(SFARI_Gene %>% select(`gene-symbol`, `gene-score`), by = c("gene" = "gene-symbol")) %>%
    mutate(score_group = ifelse(is.na(`gene-score`), "Not SFARI", as.character(`gene-score`)),
           cell_type = cell_type,
           sex = sex)

  sig %>%
    count(cell_type, sex, score_group, name = "num_sig_genes") %>%
    arrange(desc(num_sig_genes))
}

plot_sig_gene_summary <- function(summary_df, title) {
  # Set factor order for coloring if needed
  summary_df <- summary_df %>%
    mutate(score_group = factor(score_group, levels = sort(unique(score_group))))

  ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = cell_type, y = num_sig_genes, fill = score_group)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    geom_text(aes(label = num_sig_genes),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
              color = "white", size = 4) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Cell Type", y = "# Significant Genes", fill = "SFARI Gene Score") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "1" = "#bdd7e7",  # light blue
      "2" = "#6baed6",  # medium blue
      "3" = "#3182bd",  # darker blue
      "4" = "#08519c",  # darkest blue
      "Not SFARI" = "gray80"  # non-SFARI genes
    )) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "SFARI Gene Score"))
}

plot_SFARI_genes_from_subsets <- function(by_group_data, SFARI_Gene, output_dir, hormone, top_n = 6) {
  dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```
